generalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years period 2021-22 to 2025-26.

Achieved in at least Two financial years an average financial turnover of Rs.12.00 Lakhs (Usually not less than the estimated annual payments under this contract), should have in the last five years period 2021-22 to 2025-26

Mandating satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least one similar work an extent of 50% of the cost of the work Rs.3.00 Lakhs, should have in the last five years period 2021-22 to 2025-26
